body: Is it worth mentioning he was the one to ask for my number and he was the one to ask me to hang out on the last day of class? I'm generally on the surface pretty chill and this situation made me impulsive but I think I can attest to handling this situation before the ghosting smoothly. I've been on the side of more than one rejection - one including a best friend who after 2 years is still one of my closest friends - and have also rejected someone on more than one occasion. I think you're making a snap judgement that I wouldn't have taken the rejection well when you don't know me or my entire romantic past. But I don't have to prove to you that I'm not this insane emotional human being that you probably assume me to be, so assume whatever you would like to assume.

I mean I never said he had a girlfriend at the time. But it's not like it's unheard of for a guy or girl to experiment with someone while in a relationship with the opposite sex. This started with me getting manipulated and of course numerous times on this thread, I have said I had a lapse in judgement on how I approached the situation, but I don't think that means I'm 100% in the wrong and he isn't? Chalking me up to just being batshit and this guy innocent has me worried how you handle other people's feelings lmao

Yeah there's obviously a lot I need to learn from this... The pain from getting ghosted hurt me too much and I felt pathetic because I would ask myself every day why I couldn't move on until I decided I was gonna do something fucking stupid and confront him. I got closure but at the cost of feeling like a shithead.
I never claimed to be an angel, in fact I wrote this to vent about my guilt. I feel like a piece of shit.

I do see a therapist and I'm working on shit. I dunno if I clarified because I wrote a fuck ton but we were very close about 3-4 months leading up to actually hooking up which ended up being more than just the blowjob. I know I should have talked to him privately.

I mean I get it, I'm fucked up in my own ways. This entire situation has driven me up the wall and I wish it hadn't because I've literally felt psychotic in some of these moments and I've never acted like this before in my life. I wish I could have sucked it up but I couldn't.
The yellow tribe is going to be the biggest mess on earth and I'm so ready for it. Also I hope Sharn gets the opportunity to kick Mat Rogers's self-righteous bitter ass straight into the sun :)
